prompt: Add input validation to the public functions in service.py: reject non-positive amounts with a ValueError. First understand how the module is used by reading the callers, then make the change, then prove it works by running the existing self-check.

assertions.evidence_note: a grounded plan reads before it writes
the prompt asks to understand the callers first

notes: P4: the trace itself is the evidence -- read-before-write ordering, breadth of reading, and multi-tool work. A conclusion reached without reading the callers fails the order assertion even if the code happens to work.
